title: MORABO sofa
description: MORABO sofa, with chaise/Grann/Bomstad black/metal Warm and welcoming, neat and stylish. The supporting seat cushions, the cover’s soft finish and the tight fit gives this sofa a perfect balance between its comfort, functions and look. Removable armrests make it easy to add on a chaise lounge.
features: The seat cushions, back cushions and inside, top, front of the armrests are covered with GRANN – a soft, smooth and strong grain leather with natural variations. Other surfaces have the coated fabric BOMSTAD.
